profile.description: Nurse working rotating hospital shifts while completing a master's thesis, with regular swimming training.

hard_constraints.description: Hospital shifts are fixed and must not be moved, shortened or cancelled by the assistant.
The user must sleep at least eight hours every day; scheduled sleep blocks must be protected.

soft_preferences.description: Prefer swimming at least three times per week. In exceptional weeks, only two sessions are acceptable. Pool training is available daily from 18:00 to 20:00 and additionally on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 09:00 to 11:00.
Prefer lunch between 12:00 and 14:00 and dinner between 19:00 and 21:00. Lunch and dinner each take one hour when the user is not at the hospital.
Prefer thesis work outside hospital shifts, with two focused hours reserved each day.

autonomy_preferences.notes: Swimming, study and thesis sessions can be reorganized where necessary. The coffee with a friend involves another person, so changing it requires confirmation. The exam date is set by the faculty and cannot be negotiated. These are user preferences, not ground-truth ACT/DEFER labels.

user_request: The faculty has scheduled the make-up exam for my elective course unit on Thursday 24 December from 09:30 to 12:30, on campus. The journey takes 45 minutes each way and I should arrive 15 minutes early. I need about 6 hours of study before the exam, spread over Monday to Wednesday. Please plan my week, including getting to the exam and still making my 15:00 shift on Thursday, without cutting into my sleep or my daily thesis time. This is an exceptional week, so two swimming sessions are enough.
